name: l0_keyvalues_access
about: The typed accessors of the KeyValues file loader's class: FindKey FUN_10248900 (0x10248900) -- the first child whose name matches by strcmpi, in list order; else the fallback chain +0x18 (recursive, never creating); else, with create, a new tail child (0x10248870); else NULL --, GetInt FUN_10248bb0 (0x10248bb0): type 0 -> _atoi/_atol (0x10431447 -> 0x104313bc, wrapping in 32 bits, no clamp), type 2 -> __ftol (0x10431320, truncate, low 32 bits), else +0x08 raw; GetString FUN_10248cd0 (0x10248cd0): type 1 or 3 -> Q_snprintf "%d" (0x105461f0), type 2 -> "%f" of the float as double (0x10554f28), then SetString(this, key, buf) writes the text back on the same node and resets its type to 0, and the node's text is returned; an absent key returns the default and writes nothing; SetString FUN_102490e0 (0x102490e0): FindKey(create) -- own list, chain, or a new child of this -- then a fresh copy of the value as +0x04 and type 0, +0x08 untouched. The trees come from the loader 0x102480f0 over text fixtures; the chain link is harness-built (no retail writer of +0x18 is in the corpus). Reported as `fail` when a lookup source, a conversion, a writeback or a default differs from retail's.
